name: HatchGrab
subtitle: Food truck ordering and kitchen
promotionalText: Receive advance orders, protect the kitchen from excess orders and keep serving when the network fails. The ordering app for food truck teams.
description:
HatchGrab is the ordering and kitchen app for food trucks: the tool your team runs service with.

Customers order in advance and choose a collection time. Your team sees all orders on one screen, confirms what the kitchen can prepare and then marks them as ready and collected.

NEVER PROMISE A TIME YOU CAN’T MEET
State how much your kitchen can prepare at a time and how long it takes. When a collection time is full, customers can no longer choose it, so the queue keeps pace with the kitchen.

TAKE ORDERS AT THE COUNTER
Add counter (walk-up) orders on the same screen as advance orders, so the kitchen works from a single queue.

ONE SCREEN FOR THE KITCHEN
The kitchen screen shows what to prepare now, what comes next and what is ready, with an alert when an order needs starting.

PRINT ORDER TICKETS
Connect a ticket printer in the kitchen over Bluetooth or through your local network, and order tickets are printed automatically.

KEEP SERVING WHEN THE NETWORK FAILS
Turn on offline protection: if the connection drops, advance orders are paused so nobody places an order you won’t see. Orders you enter on the device are kept and are synced when you’re back online.

MADE FOR THE FOOD TRUCK
Use it on iPhone or iPad. Keep the screen on during service, get a notification when an order needs confirming and lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID.

PLAN YOUR WEEK
Set up your events and locations just once and receive orders for each of them.

HatchGrab is intended for food truck operators and their teams. You need a HatchGrab account to sign in.
